package.name: MrFreeTool
package.description: FreeCAD automation workbench for sheet-metal production: antet drawing notes (Zimba / Lazer), Qty and scale handling, automatic drawing creation from a flat pattern, TechDraw template (sheet format) swapping, flat pattern DXF and PNG export, screencap + PDF assembly sheets, part normalisation (thickness / K-factor / material properties), colour randomisation and external document reference repair.
